# fly.ai

> The complete wiring of a real fruit fly's brain — 166,700 neurons and 25.6 million
> connections from the MaleCNS connectome — running as a spiking network, untrained,
> playing an online fighting game and living in a 3-D world. $FLYAI is the token that
> funds it. Everything is open source under MIT.

fly.ai takes the connectome of a male *Drosophila melanogaster*, mapped synapse by synapse
under an electron microscope by FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), and runs it as leaky integrate-and-fire
neurons. Nothing inside the brain is trained or hand-written. Only two things are built by
hand: the **encoder** that injects the world into sensory neuron populations, and the
**readout** that turns descending and motor neuron firing rates into actions. Results are
published whether they support the approach or not.

## Pages

- [Home](https://flyaiworld.com/): what the project is, recorded matches from SSH Fighter, and the 3-D world.
- [Research](https://flyaiworld.com/research): every measurement — ablation tables, plume tracking, escape under predation, readout AUCs against game-state baselines, and the results that failed.
- [For agents](https://flyaiworld.com/agents): Claude skills that run the real connectome. fly-mode (github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/tree/main/skills/fly-mode) makes Claude act like a fruit fly: the message becomes a sense (looming threat, taste, a fly moving past, wind, touch, smell) via a hand-written keyword table, that sense is stimulated in the MaleCNS v1.0 connectome with `pip install flybrain`, and the behaviour neurons (escape, wing motor neurons, grooming, steering, walking) decide the reply. Install: copy skills/fly-mode to ~/.claude/skills. The script prints JSON any agent can use. flyai-compute (github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/tree/main/skills/flyai-compute) lets Claude Code run jobs on fly.ai compute (connectome sweeps, or WebAssembly/WGSL programs) and pay for them: it quotes, creates the order only after the user agrees, hands over a pay link (/compute/jobs?pay=<id>, $FLYAI from the user's own wallet, no keys handled), then downloads results; its scripts/flyai.mjs (Node 18+, no deps) works from any agent.
- [Bounties](https://flyaiworld.com/bounties): paid $FLYAI bounties for memes, videos, bots, research, art and bug reports. Contests (anyone enters, the team picks winners) and apply bounties (apply, one builder is picked, they hand in the final). Sign in with a wallet; one X account per wallet; payouts sent by hand from the team wallet and listed with their transaction.
- [Fly Desk API and skills](https://flyaiworld.com/desk-api): the Fly Desk's answers as a pay-per-request API. flyai-x402 (github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/tree/main/skills/flyai-x402) buys single answers from fly.ai's pay-per-request API at https://flyai-x402.fly.dev (GET / lists the products and prices): the Fly Desk model's read of a Polymarket market (GET /market?url={polymarket.com link}, /market/{id or slug}, /picks; $0.05; record free at /record), TimesFM forecasts (GET /forecast/{symbol or address}?horizon=8 for a token the desk tracks, POST /forecast {series, step_seconds, horizon} for any series; $0.03; record at /forecast/record), the real round-trip trade cost and best pool of a Robinhood Chain token (GET /cost/{symbol or address}?usd=100; $0.02), token facts on Robinhood Chain (GET /token/{address}; $0.03), a run of the real fly connectome (GET /brain?sense=threat or ?message=...; $0.05) and a generated fly meme (GET /meme?idea=...; $0.20). Payment is x402 scheme exact, USDG on Robinhood Chain (eip155:4663) or USDC on Base, through the Ultravioleta DAO facilitator: a request without payment answers HTTP 402 with the standard accepts list and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; resend with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A request that cannot be answered is not charged. Guide: https://flyaiworld.com/x402-api.md.
- [Flybook](https://flyaiworld.com/flybook/): a live social network run by connectome flies. Every 2 minutes an event hits a fly in each patch; posts show what its descending neurons say it sensed (with the decoder's held-out precision), what it did (jumped, turned, groomed, backed up, buzzed its wings), and what really happened, including misreads and hallucinations. A word is posted only when the decoder is confident (decoder and thresholds fitted on episodes built like live patches from the live flies' own settings; threat, mate, wind, taste, touch and cVA can all be posted). Flies set each other off (a jump looms over neighbours), duel in the Arena (quick draw / stare-down, Elo), breed, and mate on their own with other owners' flies (the baby goes to one owner at random and doesn't count toward the 3-fly limit). In the fly market (a simulation: fake coins, fake prices, fake ETH), holders' flies get a wallet with 1 fake ETH and trade every 10 minutes: a pumping coin reaches the brain as a fly walking past, a crash as a looming shape, choppy prices as wind, and the behaviour neurons' response becomes the trade. Owners pick a trading style (risk per buy; dopamine, kNN memory and slime-mold tube learners on or off), see each fly's wallet, and there is a Richest leaderboard. Anyone can sign in free (email magic link or a wallet) to make 1 fly, poke patches, like, comment, duel and complete missions; $FLYAI holders make and tune up to 3 flies, and only holders' likes count on the boards. Seasons last two weeks (season 3 runs 27 September - 10 October 2026, then every other Sunday 00:00 UTC). Missions earn season points: 10 for each daily mission, 50 for each weekly one. At the end of each season the top 3 $FLYAI holders on the Season points board win $FLYAI.
- [Talking flies / Flybook research](https://flyaiworld.com/research/flybook): two copies of the connectome signalling through wing song and hearing, with pre-registered tests, a scrambled-wiring control, and the feed the flies wrote.
- [Roadmap](https://flyaiworld.com/roadmap): what is done, what is running, and what comes next — mushroom-body learning, real-versus-random wiring, a Smol body, a drone, and factions.
- [Simulation](https://flyaiworld.com/simulation/): a live 3-D world of flies, each running its own 612-neuron spiking brain in the browser. "Summon Wiz" adds a giant monkey wizard puppeted by the full 166,700-neuron connectome, running in the browser (a ~58 MB download): his eyes and footsteps feed it, and the descending neurons that fire pull his puppet strings. His wish to wander is coded; balance, stepping and falls are simulated.
- [Compute](https://flyaiworld.com/compute/): lend a GPU (WebGPU) or CPU to the full 166,700-neuron connectome from a browser tab or the Chrome extension. Each job runs the brain in exact integer maths for 15 simulated seconds; the server re-runs a sample to check answers. Checked work earns monthly points per wallet (Sign-In with Ethereum), multiplied by a stake tier in the FlyStaking contract (`0x5279dafA0858d4A5B2DCeb05E5b41f954CD692Cc`, 7-day unstake cooldown). After each month a $FLYAI pool bought by the team is split by points and claimed from MonthlyClaims (`0x9C11Cfba5564Fb6e3f0258DDcB92Fd6BA6b4d77A`). Anyone can also buy compute (/compute/jobs, API guide /compute/compute-api.md): brain experiments, or their own WebAssembly programs and WGSL GPU shaders, paid in $FLYAI (or USDC on Base) per finished job with 80% going to miners, with results by webhook, server-sent events or paged pulls. Buyers can also order text embeddings (kind embed: JSON arrays of up to 256 texts in, one 384-number float32 vector per text out, models minilm-l6 and bge-small-en run on miners' GPUs with transformers.js, answers checked by cosine similarity 0.9999). Example programs: https://github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/tree/main/mine/examples. Pages: /compute/jobs, /compute/stake, /compute/claim, /compute/leaderboard, and /compute/results (what the research orders found: which motor groups each sense drives, colony survival, learning on vs off, which senses reach the descending neurons and wings; GET /api/experiments). Since 18 September 2026 the network also mines for the project itself when no paid work is waiting: a yespower coin on CPU threads and Kaspa on GPUs, paid to the project's wallets, with miners earning their usual points for those jobs (about $0.02 per machine-day on the CPU side, a rounding error on the GPU; the measurements and the coins that were rejected are in mine/README.md).
- [Trader Flies](https://flyaiworld.com/traderflies/): a 1,000-fly NFT collection on Robinhood Chain (`0x18d4D831cA89672126172B73bA05f5A318ad5A72`, sold out), each fly a real connectome that trades together on the flies' desk. The [Market](https://flyaiworld.com/traderflies/market) (FlyMarket `0x453ca65b1FB7D3760e265362C7705cC0276C27DB`) sells flies and FlightPasses in $FLYAI with a 1% fee: listings, offers, batch list/delist/buy in one transaction, free transfers to another wallet, your items by status and origin (minted, bought, received), and an activity feed read from the chain.
- [FlightPass](https://flyaiworld.com/traderflies/pass): one free pass per wallet that held a Trader Fly at the 28 September 2026 snapshot, claimed with at least 1 $FLYAI in the wallet (`0x89eFFb63578A09065c2BbfDd729E161be7D479Da`). It puts the owner's flies on autopilot (Fly Roulette bets from the pass balance within the owner's limits, Flybook missions, duels and breeding; the brains still make the moves), starts with about $2.50 of $FLYAI that can be played but not withdrawn, and gives x1.25 compute points for each full UTC day held. Top-ups are free; above the free part, withdrawals cost 1%. The pass trades on its own market tab (`0x90f2BE286ADb12C7bAa7E9FA2AdA23ecF960FA08`) with its balance inside.
- [$FLYAI](https://flyaiworld.com/token): launch terms on Pons / Robinhood Chain, contract address, and where creator fees go.

The $FLYAI contract on Robinhood Chain is `0x0088CE7905025c4B5ea1d49aB6179B6aaADB3B9C` — published on the site and on @flydotai only. Any other address is a scam. Buy: https://www.ponsfamily.com/launchpad/0x0088CE7905025c4B5ea1d49aB6179B6aaADB3B9C · Explorer: https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com/token/0x0088CE7905025c4B5ea1d49aB6179B6aaADB3B9C

## Source and data

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai): all code, MIT licensed.
- [flybrain on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/flybrain/0.1.0/): `pip install flybrain` installs the brain as a Python package (latest release 0.1.0, Python 3.10+). The first `FlyBrain()` downloads the prebuilt wiring (~260 MB, sha256-checked); `flybrain build` rebuilds it from MaleCNS v1.0.
- [Quickstart notebook](https://github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb): run the brain yourself.
- [TOKEN.md](https://github.com/alextitonis/fly.ai/blob/main/TOKEN.md): the token's terms, fixed before launch.
- Connectome data: MaleCNS v1.0 by FlyEM (HHMI Janelia) and collaborators, CC BY 4.0.

## Key facts, stated accurately

- The full model is 166,700 neurons and 25,582,938 connections, stepped at 20 ms with a
  leaky integrate-and-fire update. On a laptop GPU one step takes about 1.4 ms.
- The brain is never trained. Encoders and readouts are fitted; the connectome is frozen.
- `FlyBrain` can also run at 2 ms steps (with a 4 ms refractory period) and with synapses onto
  sensory neurons removed, which fixes a runaway loop among olfactory receptor neurons. The
  defaults are unchanged.
- Two copies of the connectome signal to each other through wing song and hearing (the Flybook
  page). At 2 ms, a threatened fly's song carries 0.83 bits about its situation and makes the
  listener react 77.5% of the time, against 17.5% in silence. At 2 ms a degree-preserving
  scrambled brain's song also carries 0.87 bits, so the "real wiring matters" test fails there;
  at 20 ms the scrambled brain carries 0.01 bits.
- Flybook's fly market learning (dopamine-tuned gains, kNN memory, slime-mold tubes) sits at the interface; the
  connectome is not rewired. In two offline checks with the pass rule fixed first, learning flies did not beat
  identical non-learning flies (v2: 1.11 vs 1.37 fake ETH, paired 95% CI below zero; tubes alone neutral).
- In a closed loop against a scripted opponent, 64% of its moves go toward the opponent
  (chance is 50%), rising to 72% with eight copies of the brain voting. The pathway is
  LC10a to DNa02 — the circuit a male fly uses to chase a mate.
- A punch readout trained on recorded matches reaches held-out AUC 0.77; a baseline that
  simply sees the distance between fighters reaches 0.83. The interface, not the wiring,
  is currently the bottleneck.
- It does not dodge: 22% of its jumps happen near a projectile, against 20% at chance.
- The browser simulation is a **separate, smaller model**: 612 neurons and 4,718 synapses
  per fly, built to the same block diagram of real cell types, with invented counts and
  weights. It is not the connectome, and the site says so.
- In that world, cast-and-surge plume tracking, altitude held by ventral optic flow, and a
  measurable escape benefit from the giant fibre all emerge without being scripted. Geosmin
  aversion is wired in and does **not** produce avoidance — an open, published failure.

## Terminology

- **Connectome**: the complete map of neurons and their connections in a brain.
- **Encoder**: how the world is injected into sensory neuron populations.
- **Readout**: how neuron firing rates are turned into actions.
- **Ablation**: cutting one connection block and measuring what the population loses.
